name: com.mytoolz.io
description: Cross-platform save/load system with pluggable serialization, encryption, file/PlayerPrefs backends, backup recovery, and awaited WebGL IndexedDB persistence, serialized mutations, and integrity-checked recovery, and authenticated (AES + HMAC) or obfuscated (XOR) payloads. Requires Zenject (https://github.com/modesttree/Zenject), SerializeReferenceExtensions (https://github.com/mackysoft/Unity-SerializeReferenceExtensions)
